hooks.name: Validate Output Config Constants
hooks.description: Assert all approved spec constants (resolution, fps, codec, durations, slide counts) are present whenever the output config file is saved.

action.command:
FILE=$(echo "$KIRO_HOOK_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('file',''))" 2>/dev/null)
if [ -z "$FILE" ]; then exit 0; fi

echo "=== Validating output config: $FILE ==="

ERRORS=""

check() {
  local label="$1"
  local pattern="$2"
  if ! grep -qP "$pattern" "$FILE"; then
    ERRORS="$ERRORS\n  ✗ $label"
  else
    echo "  ✓ $label"
  fi
}

# Video constants
check "width: 1280"            "1280"
check "height: 720"            "720"
check "fps: 30"                "\b30\b"
check "codec: h264"            "h264"
check "container: mp4"         "mp4"
check "minDuration: 30s"       "\b30\b"
check "maxDuration: 300s"      "\b300\b"
check "maxFileSize: 200MB"     "200\s*\*\s*1024\s*\*\s*1024\|209715200"
check "progressInterval: 2000ms" "\b2[_,]?000\b"
check "downloadReady: 5000ms"  "\b5[_,]?000\b"
check "cancelTimeout: 3s"      "\b3\b"

# Slide constants
check "minSlides: 3"           "\b3\b"
check "maxSlides: 15"          "\b15\b"
check "previewMaxWords: 50"    "\b50\b"
check "introMaxWords: 300"     "\b300\b"
check "specMaxHeadings: 5"     "\b5\b"
check "specMaxSentences: 3"    "\b3\b"
check "maxHighlights: 10"      "\b10\b"

if [ -n "$ERRORS" ]; then
  echo ""
  echo "❌ Output config validation FAILED. The following required constants are missing or incorrect:"
  printf "$ERRORS\n"
  echo ""
  echo "Expected values per spec:"
  echo "  VIDEO: 1280x720, h264, mp4, 30fps, 30s–300s, 200MB limit, 2000ms progress, 5000ms download, 3s cancel"
  echo "  SLIDES: min=3, max=15, previewWords=50, introWords=300, specHeadings=5, specSentences=3, highlights=10"
  exit 2
fi

echo ""
echo "✅ Output config is valid — all spec constants present."
